R1.contrast_definition: All six pairs among four models plus E3-E0 and H3-H0, each on diagnosis/evidence/plan mean scores; signs rounded at 12 decimals; zero is a separate direction.
R1.blinding: Authors confirm independent mutually blinded physician rescoring without automated scores.
R1.sampling_unit: Audited output, uniquely keyed by audit_id; episode_id alone is not unique across conditions.

surviving: C_强模型MDT - B_同模型MDT / turns
C_强模型MDT - B_同模型MDT / tests

A1.notes: One Holm family per reported scientific question; no strong-MDT triggered-only family. Utility trends are recomputed from stage means; unaffected stage diagnostics retain their original p-values.

recorded_error_usage.cost_note: Standard China-mainland pay-as-you-go list-price estimate. Actual billing can be lower because free quota, savings plans, promotions, and cache discounts are not observable here.

A5.boundary: Same card-count and truncation policy; exact token/character length matching is not established. Frozen-bank rerun does not identify a relevance benefit.

rows.scope: Calls from request-count ledger; tokens are calibrated estimates

case_record_boundary: Released 700 records represent 688 unique full contents. Stream:500 records/488 contents; heldout:200/200 with zero stream overlap; cross-sectional:100/88; model comparison:80/68. Inference pairs/resamples case records, not deduplicated independent contents.
limitations: Physician direction contrasts are descriptive group-mean signs, not paired inferential tests.
Physician audit tables use published aggregates; completed individual ratings are confidential.
Held-out subset rejudging does not establish judge stability for every final 200-case output.
Utility sensitivity always uses turn divisor 10; total-score sensitivity changes only outcome weights.

model_identity_notes.original_mdt: The final 100-case study compares no MDT, a Qwen-Turbo consultant and a Kimi-K2.5 consultant with a Qwen-Turbo primary. The consultant is selected through models.mdt_expert.
model_identity_notes.strong_primary_mdt: Primary and effective single consultant are glm-5; kimi-k2.5 is manager. Raw keys are retained for provenance.
